rationale: This scoped Experience repair implements existing constitutional Runtime-truth, deterministic-contract, failure-inspection, and independent-readiness requirements without changing constitutional meaning. Browser and Gateway bootstrap composition now derive from one frozen shared route manifest, and failed routes are validated as a unique exact set rather than as an undocumented positional sequence. Valid route-specific failures remain independently visible; an aggregate transport, timeout, or contract failure becomes one precise coordinator failure with empty replacement data so previously verified route state is not overwritten by fifteen fabricated Runtime failures. The Gateway recognizes the Runtime-owned nexus_production_readiness projection at /ready, validates its version, required fields, handler counts, readiness invariants, timestamp, secret-value marker, and HTTP 200/503 relationship, preserves the sanitized projection as data, and adapts production_ready false into one successful Degraded read. Health, production readiness, capability availability, process liveness, policy, authorization, and execution Authority remain independent. The established legacy readiness envelope remains compatible. Malformed, inconsistent, unauthorized, oversized, and transport responses still fail closed; deterministic readiness 503 responses are not retried. No generic proxy, mutation, Authority, capability promotion, production-readiness claim, Runtime change, secret change, data migration, or deployment is introduced.
